## Dr Olaoluwa Rotimi Popoola

Ola Popoola's research materials address intelligent resource allocation for 6G networks, mission-critical communications, industrial Internet of Things systems, and teleoperation. This website organises that work within four connected themes while retaining source provenance and a human review gate.

## Research interests

- Connected robotics
- Spatial intelligence
- Autonomous systems
- 6G / AI-RAN
